arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Occult Hellfire{/c} Skills consume {c_number}{SF_0}{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Hex{/u}{/c} on targets hit to increase its damage against the target by {c_number}[{SF_1}*100|x%|]{/c}. 

{c_important}Occult Abyss{/c} Skills can be empowered by {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c} to cause explosions when hitting an enemy for the first time, dealing {c_number}{payload:ABYSS_VOLATILE_EXPLOSION}{/c} damage, increased by that Skill's Rank.

Every {c_number}{SF_5}{/c} Wrath spent grants {c_number}{SF_4}{/c} {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}.
